service.description: The Summary of the user's selected plant (open, in progress, late, short and completed this month: each null where it is not counted) and its Queue of due work and shortages (none until the runs are listed). Refuses a user without Manufacturing and a plant outside the scope.

parameter.name: summary
parameter.description: openCount, inProgressCount, lateCount, shortCount and completedCount (this month), each null where not counted.

parameter.name: queueRows
parameter.description: Each row's title, url, productName, dueText, workCenterName, statusText and shortageText.

parameter.name: kpis
parameter.description: P16: the plant's Kpis this month (get#ProductionDashboard), each with its title, valueText, detail and the url of its report with the same filters; empty for a user without production read.

parameter.name: kpiStatus
parameter.description: P16: the Kpis' asOfText, periodText, complete, partitionsText and withheldText.

set.from: {openCount: null, inProgressCount: null, lateCount: null, shortCount: null, completedCount: null}
